title.en: antiques and old things at santo stefano.
title.de: antiquitäten und altes an santo stefano.
title.tr: santo stefano'da antika ve eski eşyalar.

line.en: the bologna antiques market on piazza santo stefano, 09:00 to 18:00. old prints, furniture, books and lace. best in the morning.
line.de: der antiquitätenmarkt auf der piazza santo stefano, 9 bis 18 uhr. alte drucke, möbel, bücher und spitze. am besten am vormittag.
line.tr: piazza santo stefano'daki antika pazarı, 09:00 - 18:00. eski baskılar, mobilya, kitaplar ve dantel. en iyisi sabah.

sparks.why: Mercato Antiquario Città di Bologna, Piazza Santo Stefano, Sun 8 Nov 09:00 to 18:00 (Confcommercio Ascom Bologna; BolognaToday autumn markets guide).
